QuestInfo.name: Earn 50 points on the Speed Quiz!
QuestInfo.1:
Today's Mission!
<Earn #b50 points#k on the Speed Quiz!>

Today's mission is to get #b50 points#k from the Speed Quiz. Go see #bAgent Cassandra#k to take a speed quiz on the items and monsters of Maple World. You get 1 point per question and the quiz can be taken once every 30 minutes.  You must earn a #btotal 50 points#k for today.

0.0: You want to receive today's mission again?

yes.0: Go see #bAgent Cassandra#k and take the speed quiz on the items and monsters of Maple World.  You get 1 point per question, and you can take the quiz every 30 minutes.  You must earn a #btotal of 50 points#k for today.

no.0: If you want to receive it again, just let me know.

1.0: Good job.  You have completed today's mission.  Your mission performance file is scheduled to be reported to headquarters.
